name: fm
description: Firstmate Calm for Claude Code: the sailboat working animation and conversation-only transcript presentation, sharing the per-home config/calm preference with the Pi Calm extension. Claude Code loads its hooks module on its own terms, but the mod activates only when FM_CALM_ENABLED is exactly 1, or when FM_CALM_ENABLED is unset and the deprecated alias CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS is exactly 1, and is otherwise a complete no-op.
